result.description: Private capital market data platform (companies, deals, investors, funds) with a contract-based REST API.
result.auth_detail: Static API key sent as `Authorization: PB-Token <key>` header; no OAuth flow. Not a standard bearer token. Separate sandbox key exists.
result.access_detail: API is a paid, contract-gated add-on with no free tier and no self-serve signup. Keys come from the PitchBook account manager or Direct Data team, or via Plugins & Apps for existing customers. Official docs are behind login (pitchbook.com/help returns 403 to bots).
result.api_notes: PitchBook Public API v2 at api.pitchbook.com, documented in a public Postman collection. dlt lists search/get endpoints for companies, deals, people, investors, funds. Credit-based usage (402 when credits run out). Full spec only partly public, so breadth is an estimate.
result.blocker: No self-serve credentials. API needs a paid PitchBook contract plus an account-manager-issued key, so a developer cannot get working credentials without a sales relationship.

evidence.quote: sent on every request as the `Authorization: PB-Token <key>` header
API access is a paid, contract-gated add-on with no free tier
